Some sick individual (Zack Seisler) has acquired a large supply of Permanent Killing equipment, and is using it. These PK weapons are quite new and not functioning 100% yet. (Not all people are susceptible to them, seems.) If the person with this equipment manages to encode the neural signal of the target onto the Neural Disruption Weapon, and then strikes a killing blow with it, the 'essence' or 'soul' of the victim is lost to the world! The result is terrible: no resurrection in our great resurrection machines, resulting in permanent DEATH! (As in the 'good' old way.) Please stop this lunatic before he can send more people away with no return ticket! Hurry, he is in Omni-1 Trade for 48 hours! Good luck, Shade.
